enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch arm. Remain still. Turn to back. Pull blanket down. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain still.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up. Swing legs out of bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put toothbrush down. Wash face with water. Apply soap. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reading and getting ready for the day while Member 2 uses the bathroom
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on bed. Pick up book. Open book. Read page. Turn page. Read page. Turn page. Close book. Put book down. Stand up. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Lay clothes on bed. Close wardrobe. Member 2 enters bathroom. Say 'Good morning.' Member 2 replies 'Good morning.' Sit on bed. Wait.

enriched_activities.activity: Making and eating breakfast, drinking coffee; joined by Member 2 for breakfast from 07:00 to 07:30
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs. Take out milk. Take out bread. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Open cabinet. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Toast bread. Pour milk into glass. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out mug. Put coffee in mug. Pour hot water into mug. Stir coffee. Member 2 enters kitchen. Say 'Good morning.' Member 2 says 'Good morning.' Sit at table. Eat eggs. Eat toast. Drink coffee. Talk with Member 2. Member 2 leaves at 07:30. Finish eating. Clear dishes.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt. Take out pants. Take out socks. Take out shoes. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open bag. Put laptop in bag. Put notebook in bag. Put pen in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag. Walk out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the nonprofit community centre
enriched_activities.desc: Walk out of house. Close door. Lock door. Walk to bus stop. Check phone. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to community centre. Enter building.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: planning programs and meeting community partners
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Greet colleagues. Sit at desk. Turn on computer. Open email. Read emails. Reply to emails. Open calendar. Check schedule. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Write notes. Stand up. Walk to meeting room. Meet community partner. Shake hands. Sit down. Discuss program. Take notes. Stand up. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Continue planning. Type on computer.

Walk to cafe. Enter cafe. Stand in line. Order sandwich. Pay cashier. Receive sandwich. Walk to table. Sit down. Unwrap sandwich. Eat sandwich. Drink water. Wipe mouth with napkin. Stand up. Throw trash. Walk out of cafe. Walk back to office.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as community program coordinator: coordinating volunteers and running afternoon sessions
enriched_activities.desc: Enter office. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Check email. Reply to volunteer. Make phone call. Speak on phone. Stand up. Walk to session room. Arrange chairs. Set up projector. Turn on projector. Greet volunteers. Assign tasks. Lead session. Speak to group. Write on whiteboard. Answer questions. End session. Thank volunteers. Walk back to desk. Sit down. Type report.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Bus arrives. Board bus. Pay fare. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Bus arrives at stop. Stand up. Walk to door. Get off bus. Walk to house. Open door. Enter house. Close door.

enriched_activities.activity: Cooking and eating dinner with Member 2
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Greet Member 2. Wash hands. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Take out meat. Close refrigerator. Place items on counter. Pick up knife. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add meat. Stir. Add spices. Stir. Turn off stove. Pick up plates. Set table. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Talk with Member 2. Drink water. Finish eating. Clear plates.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and wiping down the counters
enriched_activities.desc: Clear table. Scrape plates into trash. Stack dishes. Fill sink with water. Add soap. Pick up sponge. Wash dish. Rinse dish. Place dish in drying rack. Wash glass. Rinse glass. Place glass in drying rack. Wash silverware. Rinse silverware. Place silverware in drying rack. Drain sink. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Wipe counter again.

enriched_activities.activity: Tidying up and vacuuming the living area
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up magazines. Place magazines on shelf. Pick up pillows. Place pillows on couch. Pick up cups. Carry cups to kitchen. Return to living room. Plug in vacuum. Turn on vacuum. Push vacuum forward. Pull vacuum backward. Vacuum under couch. Vacuum corner. Turn off vacuum. Unplug vacuum. Wrap cord. Put vacuum in closet.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing: watching TV and browsing on the phone; joined by Member 2 from 21:00 for TV
enriched_activities.desc: Sit on couch. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Browse channels. Select movie. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Type comment. Put phone down. Watch TV. Member 2 enters living room at 21:00. Say 'Hi.' Member 2 says 'Hi.' Member 2 sits on couch. Watch TV together. Talk about movie. Pick up phone. Check message. Put phone down. Continue watching TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Showering and getting ready for bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust water temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Pick up soap. Apply soap to body. Scrub body. Rinse body. Pick up shampoo. Apply shampoo to hair. Scrub hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out of shower. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Put on pajamas. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie in bed. Pull blanket up. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Pull blanket down. Stretch leg. Turn to back. Pull blanket up. Adjust pillow. Breathe. Remain still. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Remain still.
